title: Single game-tier antenna on a radar island; coplanar z-fighting fixed; story world never arms a wave
context: The owner reported moire flicker under the solar generator and on the assembly line floor, and offered the 1,632-triangle single antenna as the radar instead of the 157 m seven-dish array. A screenshot after the Rotor print also showed a wave countdown: the run start arms a wave outside the two loop conditions already guarded.
outcome: docs/antenna-assets.lock.json pins skyward_low_d0.glb (18 m dish, Array_Slew clip) at upstream e846906; the layout gains a 20 x 20 m radar island at (-56, 34) for stage 7. Structures on slabs are placed 6 cm above the pad and the slab materials use a polygon offset, which removes the coplanar flicker. armWave returns immediately in story mode, and the acceptance asserts wave 0 six seconds after the Rotor print.
alternatives: Keep the seven-dish array: rejected, it is larger than the base.
evidence: node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story-world: PASS story-world-rotor with wave 0
npm run assets:check verifies the antenna checksum
